system.description:
Bloodline Point Cost: 0

Beginning at 1st level, as an action, you can place your palm on an object, that's not being held or worn by a hostile creature, no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. For the next 10 minutes, the object sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. You can spend 5 chakra to increase the duration of this feature on an object effected from 10 minutes to 1 hour. You can dismiss the light from as many objects you have affected as an action. You can use this feature a number of times equal to half your proficiency bonus per long rest.
